Harrisons Beauty began in a spare bedroom in Manchester in 2021, when sisters Claire and Louise Harrison got tired of watching UK customers pay more in customs charges and shipping than the products themselves cost — or wait a month for a parcel that got stuck at the border.

So they started buying stock directly from Korean brands and distributors, importing it properly and in bulk, and holding it in a small unit just outside Manchester. No. Everything is already sitting in our UK warehouse, so your order ships as a standard domestic UK parcel — no customs forms, no import duty and no surprise fees on delivery.
How do you guarantee the products are genuine?
We buy directly from the Korean brands and their authorised distributors, not from third-party marketplaces. Every batch is checked against manufacture dates before it goes on our shelves.
Standard tracked delivery takes 1–2 working days from dispatch. Orders placed before 2pm on a working day are usually packed and sent the same afternoon.
Unopened products can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. If something arrives damaged or faulty, we'll replace or refund it — just contact us with your order number.
Do you ship outside the UK?
Right now we ship to addresses within the UK only, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands & Islands, and the Channel Islands.
